name: remotion-4k-video
description: Re-render a click-driven web deck (Vite+React+TS, e.g. an audiobook presentation) into a color-faithful 4K MP4 with Remotion, then optionally mix in a subtle BGM. Encodes the hard-won rule that Remotion does NOT play CSS animations/transitions (frozen page clock per frame) and must use useCurrentFrame()+interpolate()/spring(); ships a reusable frame-driven animation primitive library, an audio-locked timeline generator (mp3 + 120ms trail), still-frame verification, and a video-copy BGM mixer.
